messages:
Olga (SEO): Quick sync — we need to finalize the SEO checklist for the 'Inference Playbook' webinar landing by EOD. Focus: keyword mapping, schema (Event+FAQ), internal links from docs, and redirects from older campaign pages. Owners? :clipboard:
Maya - Design: I can freeze layer IDs and CTA placements by 11:30 PT. Will post the UX map link.
Diego (Content): I'll finish primary and secondary keyword lists. New long-tails to target: 'inference cost benchmarks', 'serving LLMs low latency', 'GPU inference best practices'.
Theo - Eng: Redirects live in the router config. Prefer a single rule group. What's the canonical source we want? Also any concern about query param stripping?
Olga (SEO): Canonical should point to /webinars/inference-playbook-2026. Redirect plan: 301 /campaigns/inference-2024/* -> /webinars/inference-playbook-2026$1  (preserve querystring). Add hreflang? Not for this launch.
Priya (PMM): Add UTM template to all CTAs: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=inference_playbook_2026. Also add source=legacy for redirects when originating from /campaigns/*.
Theo - Eng: Copy of Netlify redirect snippet I'll apply:
```
# redirects
/campaigns/inference-2024/*  /webinars/inference-playbook-2026/:splat  301  !qs,host=redwood.ai
```
Will add rewrite to append utm_source=legacy when missing.
Maya - Design: UX map: https://drive.redwood.ai/ux/inference-playbook-v2 — hero URL is /webinars/inference-playbook-2026, resources hub /resources/inference-benchmarks, blog teaser /blog/inference-playbook-teaser.
Diego (Content): Proposed keyword->URL mapping:
'GPU inference best practices' -> /docs/gpu-inference-best-practices
'inference cost benchmarks' -> /resources/inference-benchmarks
'serving LLMs low latency' -> /webinars/inference-playbook-2026
I'll write anchor recommendations for the docs.
Olga (SEO): Internal linking: add two contextual links from /docs/gpu-inference-best-practices and /resources/inference-benchmarks into the landing 'benchmarks' subsection. Use anchor text variants A/B test: 'inference benchmarks' vs 'latency and cost benchmarks'.
Priya (PMM): A/B note — set experiment param ?ab=anchorA or anchorB on test CTAs so we can track conversions in GA4.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window 18:00 UTC — perform smoke checks and structured-data validation post-deploy.
Olga (SEO): Schema: include Event + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage snippets. Example Event JSON-LD:
```
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference — Inference Playbook: Launch & Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T18:00:00Z",
  "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/inference-playbook-2026",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/inference-playbook-2026"}
}
</script>
```
Diego (Content): I'll craft 3 FAQ Q/A pairs to include in the landing and mark them as FAQPage. Will keep answers short for snippet eligibility.
Theo - Eng: Post-deploy checklist I will run: 1) verify 301s, 2) canonical header on blog teaser points to landing, 3) JSON-LD present and served, 4) check UTM on CTAs. Ping me if smoke fails.
Olga (SEO): Owners recap — Diego: keywords & FAQ copy (EOD), Maya: UX/URL map (11:30 PT), Theo: deploy + redirects (18:00 UTC), Priya: UTM spec + AB params (confirm by 16:00 PT). I'll run schema validation at 19:00 UTC and post results. React with :white_check_mark: when each item is done.
Maya - Design: :white_check_mark: URL map uploaded.
Diego (Content): Will post final keyword file and anchor suggestions by 15:30 PT. :thumbsup:
Priya (PMM): UTMs and AB params confirmed. :thumbsup:
Theo - Eng: Scheduling deploy. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy schema check passed (19:03 UTC) — JSON-LD Event + Breadcrumb + FAQ detected. No critical errors.
Olga (SEO): Nice — will do final crawl and submit sitemap update. Thanks team! :tada:
